top5: Vote (3 against Me) to cover several themes (Amazon/environment, digital transition, social networks, AI) linked by internet as the common thread, in the form of a one-day kermesse

Activities: a caramentran shaped like Jeff Bezos burned at the end, a knock-'em-down game with social networks as the targets, an Amazon delivery race by bike around the village with Amazon delivery drivers (regional champion), Alexa as the AI/DJ (AI ducks dropped as too costly), VR for the elderly

Participants: residents of the EHPAD (Roquemaure retirement home), Amazon delivery drivers, the village (Montfaucon); streamer Gotaga too expensive (~100k), maybe a small local streamer; bus to be requested from the municipality
Date set to 8 May (spring); 2 January and October rejected
Money: 2 € entry fee, a bar plus pistou soup and local producers; the treasury is short so the group must seek grants from the town hall, département, region and Europe

X.comment: The three items are accurate (the 8 May date is the one key fact), but it leaves out the themes vote, the kermesse format, almost all the activities, the entry fee and the grants, and lists no next steps at all.

wrong: 'Proposer une date tentative pour la kermesse en octobre ou janvier': contradicts the transcript; the date was set to 8 May and October and 2 January were rejected
'location du bus pour la maison de retraite à Montélimar': the retirement home is in Roquemaure; Montélimar is where the Amazon warehouse is
'canards IA sont suggérés' and 'pentathlon Amazon' are given without saying the ducks were dropped and the pentathlon was cut back to a bike delivery round the village
Y.comment: Broad coverage of the themes decision, activities and grants, but it gets the key fact (the date) wrong, puts the retirement home in the wrong place, and has unowned next steps with a duplicate about grants.
